findings.title: Phase 4 gate overdue day counts stale across 5 docs (39→41 days, 2026-07-13→2026-07-15)
findings.detail: Seven day-count references across plan.md (×3), README.md (×2), docs/ifleet-integration-adrs.md (×1), docs/proposer-spec.md (×1), and docs/quota-pacing-design.md (×1) were stale. Phase 3 soak completed 2026-06-04; as of 2026-07-15 that is 41 days since completion (Phase 4 gate evaluation overdue). README soak-elapsed count updated from 53→55 days. quota-pacing-design.md had a slightly older figure (35 days as of 2026-07-09) also updated to 41 days as of 2026-07-15.
